title: Metamorphic Testing of Learned Spatial Surrogates for Transit Accessibility
abstract: arXiv:2611.32373v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transit-network design requires evaluating many candidates, but detailed accessibility calculations are too slow to repeat inside an optimization loop. We therefore train a neural surrogate to approximate them. Given a candidate bus network and fixed information about rail service and nearby opportunities, it predicts the calculated spatial change in accessibility. We compare its predictions with routing-derived targets in geographically held-out regions and test specified qualitative relations under controlled input changes. Reference calculations on constructed networks assess the applicability of relations that have a routing-level counterpart. Models with positive predictive skill can still fail basic connectivity tests. One targeted intervention substantially increases pass rates for two connectivity relations while predictive skill also improves. Average prediction error is therefore insufficient when a learned model becomes an opt

translated_title: 公共交通可达性学习型空间代理模型的蜕变测试
translated_abstract: 公交网络设计需要评估大量候选方案，但精细的可达性计算过于缓慢，无法在优化循环内反复执行。因此，我们训练了一个神经代理模型来近似这些计算。给定一个候选公交网络以及关于轨道服务和周边机会的固定信息，该模型预测可达性的空间变化。我们在地理上留出的区域中将模型预测与基于路径规划计算的目标进行比较，并在受控输入变化下测试指定的定性关系。通过在构造网络上进行的参考计算，评估了那些在路径规划层面存在对应关系的蜕变关系的适用性。研究表明，具有正预测技能的模型仍可能无法通过基本的连通性测试。一种针对性的干预措施显著提高了两种连通性关系的通过率，同时预测技能也有所改善。因此，当学习型模型成为优化器的一部分时，仅依靠平均预测误差是不够的。
tldr: 本文对用于近似公交可达性计算的学习型神经代理模型进行蜕变测试，发现平均预测误差不足以衡量模型可靠性——预测技能良好的模型仍可能无法通过基本连通性测试，而一种针对性干预可同时提升连通性测试通过率与预测准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper applies metamorphic testing to learned neural surrogates for transit accessibility, showing that average prediction error alone is insufficient since models with positive predictive skill can still fail basic connectivity tests, while a targeted intervention improves both pass rates and predictive accuracy.
